## Full description (max 4000)

BazaarX Seller is for shop owners selling on BazaarX.

- Apply to sell and send your business and bank details for verification.
- Get a sound and a notification when a new order arrives; accept or decline it in time.
- Pack orders and ship them with a courier, with tracking numbers.
- Add products in a few steps, save drafts any time, and publish when ready.
- Keep stock current, pause your shop when you are busy, and set your opening hours.
- See your earnings, request payouts and download monthly statements.
- Reply to reviews and customer questions, handle returns, and get help from the BazaarX team.

You need a BazaarX seller account. New shops are reviewed before they go live.
